name: Crew Quarters
narrativeOnEnter: Crew bunks. Personal items scattered — whoever left did so fast. A data pad on one pillow.

action.text:
MERIDIAN STATION ALPHA — CREW IDENTIFICATION

Name: CHEN, YUKI
Role: Navigation Officer
Crew ID: #0447

Navigation override panel — Medical Bay.
Manual switch access code: B=ON, C=ON (A and D remain OFF).

Handwritten note on the back:
'Pod bay code — last four of mission stamp: 5519
DO NOT WRITE DOWN — but I always forget it.'

A personal photograph. Four crew members in orange jumpsuits, posing in front of an airlock. They're smiling.

Written on the back in blue ink:
'Meridian Alpha, Launch Day — Year 3'

One of them has a name tag: CHEN.

PERSONAL LOG — CHEN, YUKI

Entry 44:
'Reactor throwing warnings. Kovalev's gone to check.
If this goes sideways:
— Wiring schematic is in the Engineering panel cover
— Reactor sequence is in the safety manual on Reactor Deck
— Cargo lock pattern is on the freight manifest
Pod bay code is on my ID tag.'

Entry 45:
'Found an unlogged container in cargo. Δ Medical Dynamics. Six devices inside.
Kovalev said: Synaptic Response Recorders. One behind every bunk vent panel. Running since launch — 63 days.
He said: I'm going to fix it.'

Entry 46 (last entry):
'Kovalev says the buffer data has to burn. The other ship is at 148.350 MHz — flagged by CALLISTO.
If MERIDIAN-3 boards us: do not trust them.
— Yuki Chen'

Two bunks. One stripped — sticky note on the frame:
'Reactor sequence: ask Kovalev.'

A torn note on the floor:
'148.350 MHz — CALLISTO. Do NOT signal MERIDIAN-3.
HELIOS GROUP = AXIOM. The shuttle isn't rescue — it's extraction.
CALLISTO has the Blackwood files. Contact them.'

Other bunk — rumpled. Kovalev's paperback:
'Nav override in Med Bay runs on manual switches — biometric scanner offline.'
